name: What are the common types of materials used for handrails?

mainEntity.name: What are the common types of materials used for handrails?

acceptedAnswer.text: Handrails are commonly made from various materials, each offering different aesthetics, durability, and maintenance requirements. Popular options include wood (such as oak or maple) for a classic look, metal (like aluminum, steel, or wrought iron) for strength and modern appeal, and composite materials which combine durability with low maintenance. Glass handrails are also an option for a contemporary, open feel, often paired with metal supports. The best choice depends on the installation location (indoor or outdoor), desired style, and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common handrail materials include wood, metal (aluminum, steel, wrought iron), composite, and glass. Each offers distinct aesthetics, durability, and maintenance.
